scope: Correction of three purported 49-frame LoRA smoke conclusions
summary: The 185000Z, 190000Z, and 191500Z runs were configured by their launchers as 49-frame attempts, but recursive overlay registration selected an older experiment definition; their official saved configs prove the effective dataloader remained 93 frames and state_t remained 24.
evidence: The 185000Z official config.yaml and printed config both record dataloader_train.dataset.num_frames=93 and pipe_config.state_t=24.
Multiple PhiAgent overlay modules registered the same Hydra experiment name during recursive import, so import order selected the older definition.
Their OOM observations remain valid for the effective 93-frame workloads, but they are not evidence about 49-frame memory use.
lessons: Always verify the framework-saved effective config rather than relying only on launcher intent.
Exactly one active overlay must be present in the recursively imported experiment directory.
limitations: No valid 49-frame optimizer-step evidence exists yet.
next_actions: Use archived overlay staging and synchronize pipe_config.state_t with the actual short-window pixel-frame count.
